system.description:
Required Weapon: Rapier & Cape Originally a bullfighting style, Torres uses the cape for distraction and defense while the rapier lands precise attacks.

  • Matador's Flourish. You may spend a Hope to adopt a stance focused on avoiding lethal harm while waiting for an opportunity. Until the end of the scene or you take Major ir higher damage, you may mark any number of Stress to gain a bonus to Evasion equal to the amount spent. While in this stance, your attacks deal 1d4 extra damage.
  • Olé, Not Today. Once per Rest, spend a Hope to negate the damage of an attack targeting you or an ally within Melee.
  • The Crowd’s Roar. When you would fail a Reaction Roll during a combat scene, you may reroll and use the new result. If the reroll still fails, the GM gains a Fear.
